# The bandit releases install_bandit installs with verify_checksums: strict,
# newest first, each as a requirements file that pins bandit and every
# dependency to one version with the SHA-256 of each wheel the orb can install
# (CPython 3.10 to 3.14 on Linux x86_64 and aarch64, glibc or musl). uv
# installs a block with --require-hashes, so a file whose hash isn't listed,
# or a package the block doesn't pin, fails the install before anything runs.
#
# Add a release with:
#   src/install/lock.sh -t bandit -v <version>
# and paste its output at the top. Make the locks again when a dependency
# gets a security fix: the audit job checks them.

# >>> bandit 1.9.4 >>>
